TechRepublic Enterprise Spotlight Member:

	Forrester Research wants to know: Are you maintaining your most important asset - your people? With the proliferation of automated processes and outsourcing, it's dangerously easy to overlook employee satisfaction and productivity. 

	According to a new Forrester Research Brief, best practices for managing an organization's IT operations must include a sharp focus on staff development and appreciation. This doesn't necessarily mean sending the team to Hawaii - it can be as simple and cost-effective as enabling employees with secure remote access. 

	Download the Forrester Research Brief to learn how leveraging the power of your human resources with Web-based remote access leads to:
	





• 

Increased productivity and reduced IT costs



• 

Greater flexibility with zero additional IT burden



• 

Higher employee satisfaction, retention and work/life balance



Download the Research Brief Now

	Please forward this invitation to colleagues who are interested in learning more about remote access.
